'''Rowdy''' was [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo's]] [[R9-series astromech droid]] and co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of her [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] when she left [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to assist [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] in their [[Mission to the Maw|assault]] against [[Abeloth]]. Rowdy participated in a battle against [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] under the control of Abeloth, as well as the subsequent [[Skirmish near Ashteri's Cloud|skirmish]] defending the ''[[Rockhound]]'' against [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] pirates.

Jaina had recently tinkered with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], adding a humor protocol to its abilities, giving him the name "Rowdy". She did not exactly enjoy Rowdy's humor, comparing it to the jokes her late brother, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], had told in their childhood.

==Behind the scenes==
In the audio version of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', Rowdy is portrayed as having a neutral, monotone voice even when attempting humor at stressful times, such as combat.
